diagnosis: ProductTranslationPreviewViewSet provides a preview of localized product descriptions. The action performs an unscoped lookup CatalogProduct.objects.get(pk=pk) without checking that the product belongs to request.user.vendor. An attacker can preview confidential, unreleased draft product copy and regional marketing campaigns belonging to competing vendors.
exploit_request:
GET /api/products/481/preview_locale/?locale=de HTTP/1.1
Host: marketplace.vendorgate.net
Authorization: Bearer cc11dd22...
Accept: application/json
